items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: There were a few bands that came through Nashville, there, with trumpet players like Ed Swayzee... They came through there with a show. And that's the first time I ever heard jazz.

ctx.x: There were a few bands that came through Nashville, there, with trumpet players like Ed Swayzee, and Joe Hayman, they came through there with a band called the Clowns, they all had clown suits on. They came through there with a show. And that's the first time I ever heard jazz. Only time was when the travelling bands would come through Nashville and play the Bijou Theater. Then we would sit -- we wouldn't have to play, but we would go in free every night and we'd hear these different bands. Groups. Some very good…
